en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing the interior lobby of an ornate early 20th‑century hotel. The room features large classical columns with decorative capitals, high decorated ceilings with light fixtures, rugs on the floor, and numerous armchairs, rocking chairs, and tables arranged in a spacious seating area. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the lobby of Hotel Lankershim in Los Angeles, California. A red number "6799." is printed in the upper right corner of the card.
